answer: Unrepeatable Answer Ledger. Each identity must submit a fresh answer to a challenge derived from its own prior ledger state plus the current ridge of committed hashes; duplicates are rejected at commit time. A new identity costs a solved challenge and a unique sable-marked seed, and copying another’s answer fails because the seed differs. Attackers must solve every challenge independently, paying full compute per identity, while honest agents reuse one seed under a lantern of audited history.
